When Uncertainty Becomes the Recession

In micro, uncertainty was one person's problem, shareable through insurance. In macro, when everyone is anxious at once, nobody is left to insure with.

Fear of losing a 💼 job tomorrow closes wallets today. When everyone saves at once, 🏪 shop sales fall and the economy cools. Firms, fearing bad news, also postpone big investments. No average has gotten any worse. A recession can start from anxiety alone.

For example, imagine all your classmates start saving their 💰 allowance. Each one is just bracing for a rainy day. But if nobody buys 🍬 candy, the shopkeeper orders less stock. Nothing bad has happened yet, and already the neighborhood has gone quiet.

Examples & Exercises

A household earns 100100100 today and 606060 tomorrow — or 202020 if it loses its job (u=xu = \sqrt{x}u=x​, β=0.9\beta = 0.9β=0.9).

How does its saving change between a job-loss probability of 000 and one of 40%40\%40%?

Show proof

  1. With no risk, tomorrow's income is a sure 606060 and optimal saving is about 11.511.511.5 (consumption today 88.588.588.5) — the point where tomorrow's marginal utility, scaled by β\betaβ, balances today's.

  2. At a 40%40\%40% job-loss risk, optimal saving exactly doubles to 232323.

    The utility curve is far steeper in the bad state, so the mere possibility of a poor tomorrow pulls consumption today down to 777777.

    Saving is set by the worst case, not by average income.

  3. For one household this is wise self-insurance, but if every household does it at once, today's aggregate demand falls by the same amount — the paradox of thrift, restarted by fear.

An irreversible factory investment costs 100100100 and will be worth 110±40110 \pm 40110±40 tomorrow (that is, 150150150 or 707070, fifty-fifty).

Expected profit says invest now — what happens if the firm waits until tomorrow instead?

Show proof

  1. Investing now has expected profit 110−100=10110 - 100 = 10110−100=10. The bad state's loss of 303030 is already inside that average.

  2. Waiting lets the firm invest only in the good state: 0.5⋅(150−100)+0.5⋅0=250.5 \cdot (150 - 100) + 0.5 \cdot 0 = 250.5⋅(150−100)+0.5⋅0=25.

    Even after the one-period delay discount of 0.950.950.95, that is 23.7523.7523.75 — far above investing now at 101010.

    The pure flexibility is worth 25−10=1525 - 10 = 1525−10=15.

  3. The mean 110110110 never moved; only the spread grew, from 000 to 404040, and the decision flipped. Waiting starts to win once the spread passes about 11.111.111.1 — uncertainty itself is what freezes the investment.
